assume.how_text: Each sensor sees within its horizontal and vertical field of view up to its reach; the reach shrinks towards the edge of the view. Exterior walls and walls from 20 cm block. Walls from 10 to 19 cm damp by 25 dB, thinner ones by the value of the slider. Tall furniture damps by 10 dB, closed doors by 6 dB. This is a model, not a measurement.
